description: This file defines the 'Cashier' entity class in the Fineract project, representing a cashier in the teller domain. It includes properties mapping to database columns, creation and update methods, and utilities for handling cashier schedules and details.

classes.name: Cashier
classes.description: Represents a cashier entity with scheduling, description, and related staff/teller information, mapped to 'm_cashiers' table with unique constraints.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new Cashier instance from JSON parameters, including associated Office, Teller, Staff, and schedule details.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the Cashier instance properties based on a JSON command, tracking changes for auditing or partial updates.

methods.name: getHourFromStartTime
methods.description: Extracts the hour component from the 'startTime' string.

methods.name: getMinFromStartTime
methods.description: Extracts the minute component from the 'startTime' string.

methods.name: getHourFromEndTime
methods.description: Extracts the hour component from the 'endTime' string.

methods.name: getMinFromEndTime
methods.description: Extracts the minute component from the 'endTime' string.
